_info: Forest enclosure for the ground robot (UGV) simulation: a fenced woodland paddock, like a deer park or a zoo enclosure, with a cleared strip outside the fence where the robot patrols. Local coordinates in metres: x = east, y = north. Change it and run ./ugv.sh again; sim/gen_forest.py regenerates worlds/forest.sdf and worlds/forest_meta.json.

forest._info: Trees in a band around the fence. corridor_m: no trees this close to the robot's route (pinch points may come closer); fir_corridor_m: no spruce this close (their low tiers would overhang the strip). meadow_edges: fence edges in a clearing (no trees on either side: open sky, good GPS).

robot._info: The robot drives outside the fence with the fence on its left (the polygon is counter-clockwise), camera looking left.

gps._info: GNSS under canopy, applied by tools/ugv_relay.py. Sky cover: the share of the sky above a 15 degree elevation mask that the tree crowns around the robot (within 20 m) hide, each weighted by foliage_block (leaves attenuate the signal rather than stop it). Noise and a slowly wandering multipath bias grow with sky cover; above no_fix_cover there is no fix.

odom._info: Wheel odometry error added by tools/ugv_relay.py on top of Gazebo's (near perfect) skid-steer odometry, like encoders on mud and roots, only while the robot moves: distance scale error, turn scale error and a heading drift per distance travelled (a few percent of the distance over a loop).
